3:84525.reason: Tampermonkey accepts this as an internal alias only for CPT 84525 with a verified matching PDF; LOINC denotes a 24-hour urine measurement, so not generally equivalent to serum/plasma 3094-0.

3:83719.reason: Calculated VLDL LOINC; CPT 83719 denotes direct testing. Requires method and billing review.

locallyAcceptedPairs.basis: User explicitly confirmed the distinct observed CPT/LOINC pairs as accepted for their DoH claim-review workflow; this is local mapping acceptance, not a regulator-published CPT/LOINC crosswalk.

mappingCaveats.3:82670:53766-2: LOINC 53766-2 is the estrogen-fraction serum/plasma PANEL (order), not the same observation concept as 2243-4 estradiol result. Locally allowed CPT association only; no claim of result-code equivalence.
mappingCaveats.3:82043:32294-1: LOINC 32294-1 represents urine albumin/creatinine RATIO, not urine albumin concentration. Locally accepted administrative association only; ratio cannot be numerically equated to concentration.
mappingCaveats.3:82728:24373-3: LOINC 24373-3 is ferritin mass/volume in BLOOD; distinguish from specimen-specific serum/plasma ferritin if enforcing specimen rules later.
